authority: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
checks: ground-truth points are independently surveyed for LIDAR verification
ground-truth surveys use flat unambiguous surfaces such as car parks or tennis courts
a ground-truth survey contains a few hundred points
ground-truth points are captured using GPS
each ground-truth point has plus or minus 3cm RMSE accuracy
attributes include survey date surface type survey method transformation and geoidal model
ground truth can be reused only when younger than 5 years or 3 years for coastal projects
timestamped LIDAR is compared to ground truth using RMSE standard deviation and random error
LIDAR must be below plus or minus 15cm RMSE to pass QC
standard deviation and random error must each be below 10cm to pass QC
